7-01.plan: Enter the individual's role on the project (e.g., project manager, fiscal contact).
7-01.source: Enter the project role of the contact person (e.g., project manager, fiscal contact). Additional contacts are optional.

7-03.source: Select the Prefix from the provided list or enter a new Prefix not provided on the list.

7-04.source: Enter the First Name. This field is required.

7-06.source: Enter the Last Name. This field is required.

7-07.source: Select the Suffix from the provided list or enter a new Suffix not provided on the list.

7-09.source: Enter the Organizational Affiliation of the person to contact on matters related to this application.

7-10.plan: Enter the first line of the street address.
7-10.source: Enter the first line of the Street Address. This field is required.

7-12.source: Enter the City. This field is required.

7-14.plan: Select the state. This field is required if the country is the United States.
7-14.source: Select the state, US possession or military code from the provided list. This field is required if Country is the United States.

7-16.source: Select the Country from the provided list. This field is required.

7-17.plan: Enter the zip / postal code. This field is required if the country is the United States.
7-17.source: Enter the Postal Code (e.g., ZIP code). This field is required if Country is the United States.

7-18.source: Enter the daytime Telephone Number. This field is required.

7-20.source: Enter a valid Email Address. This field is required.

7-11.plan: Enter the second line of the street address.
7-11.source: Enter the second line of the Street Address.

notes: key-contacts.ts:4: The DAT stars State and Zip but answers "No" in its Required column; both are required only for a US address.
key-contacts.ts:25: Every help text that differs from the DAT, pinned word for word.
